comments.body:
Thanks for this, and for the clear repro. Returning a vector cached for a different `input_type` is a real bug, and we want to fix it.

We're going to handle it ourselves rather than merge this PR. A maintainer is already reworking how `EmbeddingsCache` builds its keys, on a branch that changes the key format and moves existing entries to the new keys when they're read. This PR also changes the key, for any call that passes provider kwargs, by adding them to the model name. Shipping both would put users through two key changes one after the other. Entries cached by calls that passed provider kwargs would also be left orphaned, with no migration, and `model_name` would hold a mix of the model and a kwargs digest. Because a key change affects everyone with an existing cache, we'd like the kwargs to become part of the new key in that same change, with one migration path.

Could you open an issue with the Cohere example from your description? You've described the problem more clearly than we could, and the fix will link to the issue and close it. We'll close this PR in favour of that work. Your fake vectorizer and the sync/async coverage are a good model for the tests we'll need, and we'll credit you in the change.
